subject: Show connected users in application log

messages.author: a60b0d6ac087f297
messages.subject: Show connected users in application log
parts:
Is there any way to record the user who was connected and kicked off the sequence of events in the application logs? It'd be nice to know who was logged in and when.

Thanks!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Show connected users in application log
parts:
We don't have such a feature, but it is a good one to add to our list.  We have been thinking about auditing for RStudio Server Pro and Shiny Server Pro, but we hadn't talked about it for shinyapps.io
I will add it to our backlog, and probably reach out to you to talk about what are the types of actions you would want to see in the logs.  A shiny application could literally have thousands of events during the course of someone interacting with the application so thinking through what would be useful to keep is hard.
-Tareef

Is there any way to record the user who was connected and kicked off the sequence of events in the application logs? It'd be nice to know who was logged in and when.

Thanks!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Show connected users in application log
parts:
Alternatively, you could also consider logging the data yourself directly by putting in code within your server block.
You would be able to log information when the session first starts for the user by putting it first in there.  You can log something at the end of the session by registering a handler to be run at the session end by doing something like:
session$onSessionEnded(function() { // do your logging here } )


http://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/session.html
